Stealth Health-Tech Startup | Senior Backend/Infrastructure Engineer | San Francisco | ONSITE | Full-time | [salary range] + generous equity

We're a rapidly growing, venture-backed stealth startup helping people understand their medical records and lab results. We need an engineer to own security (HIPAA/SOC 2, KMS, IAM, audit logging), indexing and querying large volumes of medical data in Postgres, and scaling a serverless backend as traffic grows.

Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, AWS serverless (Lambda, Aurora Postgres, SQS, Step Functions), CDK.

Apply (5 min): https://forms.gle/N9U7zkz2zaUUtunV7
